notes.it: Materiali: rimossi WebApp e Open materials. Ricerca sempre in tutti i campi, compresi i docenti, senza selettore. Ricerca per nome edificio e aula: UniAuditorium/auditorium, UniHall, UniLabs, UniCongress e Aula Magna/Rossa/Blu/Verde/Gialla/Arancione o numerata. Solo il gruppo selezionato. Solo macOS.
notes.en: Materials: removed WebApp and Open materials. Search always uses all fields, including lecturers, without a scope selector. Building and room names are searchable: UniAuditorium/auditorium, UniHall, UniLabs, UniCongress and named or numbered classrooms. Selected group only. macOS only.
